meta.title: Sidebar groups
meta.description:
Splits the sidebar into two independently collapsible groups: the global panel list and the workspace/session list, remembering each group's state.

Usage: with the sidebar expanded, a "Panels" header appears above the panel rows; click the row to collapse or expand that group ("More" collapses with it). An arrow appears to the left of the workspace section header; click it to collapse or expand the session list. The search field and the add-workspace button stay usable while collapsed, and typing in the search field expands the list temporarily. Both states are stored in the browser (dsh-sidebar-groups/v1) and survive reloads and restarts. While the sidebar is collapsed to the 56px rail the group headers hide and the states are kept.

Limitations: this plugin enhances the sidebar through the stable markers the host reserves for integrators (data-sidebar-scrollport, data-sidebar-workspace-header, data-sidebar-list-area). It does not take over or replace the official sidebar. If a future DSH release changes those markers, the plugin degrades to doing nothing instead of breaking the sidebar; disabling or uninstalling it restores the sidebar completely.
